name: tool_routine_automation_python
description: Creates or updates automation/optimization routines by describing the routine logic as a small Python-like snippet instead of nested JSON.

id.description: The routine ID to edit, or null if creating a new routine.

comment.description: A short description of what this routine does.

code.description: Python-like source implementing the routine. Must be exactly one top-level `if <condition>: ... else: ...` statement using only the documented builtin functions (device(...), wait(...), repeat(...), every(...), at(...), weekly_at(...), weekly_between(...), weekly_for(...), between(...), param(...)). No imports, assignments, elif, while, or any other Python construct is allowed. See the system prompt for the full grammar and worked examples.
